cards.name: Codaedalus
cards.desc:
2 WATER monsters
You can only Special Summon "Codaedalus(s)" once per turn. This card's name becomes "Umi" while on the field. If this card is Link Summoned: You can activate this effect; during the End Phase of this turn, add 1 card from your GY to your hand that mentions "Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon", except "Codaedalus". Once per turn: You can send 1 face-up "Umi" you control to the GY; send up to 2 Spells/Traps on the field to the GY.
